At Hippocampus

Photos from the restaurant’s Google listing.

Lounge, rooftop and a vegan menu

Hippocampus is a lounge restaurant on Protaras Hotel Avenue in Paralimni, open every day from 12:00 to 01:00. Besides the main menu it has a separate vegan menu, and guests praise the sushi, the lamb shank and the friendly staff. Among the review keywords Google lists a playground for kids, shisha and the rooftop. Its own photos show white chairs under a bougainvillea covered pergola and a building lit in blue at night.

The address hippocampus-restaurant.com.cy shows only a “Coming Soon” page with a 2017 copyright, and the website field in the Google listing leads to a link page of the hosting provider. Checked on 21 September 2026.

What guests say

From the Google listing, 4.6 stars on average across 1,496 reviews.

“It was a great experience! The food was excellent, the service as well! Very friendly and attentive staff. We got the Falafel tacos, Avocado Sushi, vegan Ravioli & the vegan Mushroom Rigatoni. The vegan Pistachio Cheesecake was my favorite. The whole table (especially the non vegans) were in awe.”
Google review
“Just the most special place. From the moment you arrive the service is exceptional and is followed by innovative amazing dishes. One of our go to restaurants when we are out and normal visit at least 2 times.”
Google review
“The sushi was absolutely delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented. In fact, it was the best sushi I’ve had in Cyprus so far. Every roll was full of flavor and made with high-quality ingredients.”
Google review
“Best food I had in Cyprus! Highly recommend the black angus steak. Also suggest the upper levels to get a nicer view and more intimate/romantic setting.”
